**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

Section 9.4 read with Section 29.4 delivers our preferred position exactly: Customer may terminate the Agreement or any Order Form without cause on thirty days' written notice, owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor must refund prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by Section 10.2). There is no early-termination fee or other penalty mechanic.

Direction check: Vendor has no convenience right anywhere in the document — its termination rights are confined to uncured material breach (9.1) and insolvency (9.2) — so Vendor cannot walk away during the three-year term (8.1). No changes proposed.
